## History

Frank Stockley is a student whose uncle serves on the board of governors for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). He shared this information with his fellow peers around the time [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and other [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students were preparing for their studies at the academy.
